dict.string: Jarvis keeps your day in Calendar: he shows today's events on the Today page, nudges you before they start, and adds or moves events when you ask. Everything stays on this Mac and in your own calendars.

Jarvis keeps your tasks in Reminders, so they reach your phone and watch: he shows them on the Today page, adds what you capture, and checks things off when you ask. Everything stays on this Mac and in your own lists.
Tesseract Agent uses Accessibility to register global keyboard shortcuts for dictation, text-to-speech, and agent voice input.
